mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and 74 degrees at Fireman's Park today.

The City of Verona is preparing for a busy Plan Commission meeting on November 4th to discuss projects including the Ardent Glen addition and site plans for 1979 Milky Way. Additionally, property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th.

We have a packed schedule with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow. Don't forget the Main Street Trick or Treat event this coming Wednesday.
The Verona Police Department issued a report regarding an incident on Thursday, October 15th, where a school bus driver was arrested for O W I while transporting students.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Snickers Swirl. The shop is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:00 PM tonight.
